description: Read the font at story index of a text frame: font_family, font_style (the exact style name to use in apply_character_format_to_range or define_paragraph_style), font_status (installed, substituted, not_available), available_styles[] of that family as installed, point_size, paragraph_style, character_style (localized name) and character_style_is_none. Read-only.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

index.description: Story index of the character (from get_frame_text).

name: get_font_info_at_index
title: Font at a character
